tree_reconciliation.note: The project names a wager by the actor's total commitment since the root and the reference names the chips going in on this street; the restated labels have to match, so the chips still have to agree. Where the project deals the river after a called all-in the reference ends the hand at a turn showdown; those lines hold no policy row and are reported per case under called_all_in_run_outs.

existing_gate.ev_scope: Action EVs follow each respective policy; root residuals are not per-hand error bounds. Only the runouts named in export_runouts are compared; both sides solved every runout.

rule.status: Decision 14 candidate. Caleb has not confirmed the three thresholds; the oracle agreement tolerance is a floating-point bound, measured at 6.9e-13 chips over the 817 real-gap rows of the gate cases. Nothing outside this file may cite them as decided, and the committed review records the hash of the file it was generated under.
